title: Does age-limit still fail to move mean length at 3000 updates?
author: glitchfox
question: With death of old age switched off, do genomes at update 3000 end up longer on average than with it on? Follow-up to example-age-limit (NOT HELD at 1500): tests whether the pin near ancestor length was just too few updates.
why_this_could_be_wrong: Even with twice the updates, fast short copiers may still pin length near the 100-instruction ancestor; aging may not be the force that keeps genomes short.
